description: Verify that the SD Reboot Flag of the notification is 1 (after reboot)
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: SD Reboot Flag must equal 1 (after reboot). The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's SD Reboot Flag == 1 (after reboot)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
SD Reboot Flag on the wire equals 1 (after reboot).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_reboot_flag — Reboot flag not set
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted SD Reboot Flag == 1 (after reboot) — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
